_revision_note: Engineering pilot only. The pilot agent MUST resolve and pin the exact commit hash into this field (huggingface_hub.model_info(...).sha) before running, and record it in the trace metadata.
_attn_implementation_note: GptOssPreTrainedModel._supports_sdpa is False in transformers 5.16.1 (attention sinks), so attn_implementation='sdpa' raises at load time. 'eager' is the only dependency-free option; flash_attention_3 via the kernels hub is not installed.

quantization._note: Native MXFP4 experts (transformers Mxfp4Config, dequantize=False). Requires the kernels package (installed) and triton >= 3.4 (3.7.1 installed) on a compute-capability >= 7.5 GPU (RTX 5090 is 12.0). If the quantizer falls back to dequantize=True it will emit a warning and load ~40 GB of bf16 experts: abort rather than let it fill the card. The MXFP4 path replaces GptOssMLP.forward, which is why the gpt_oss router adapter hooks mlp rather than mlp.router.

_generation_channels_note: Records the first generated-token index at which each harmony channel marker completes (analysis / commentary / final) into trace.json. Routing is captured for every generated token, analysis channel included.
